description: This file defines the REST API resource for managing staff members in the system. It includes endpoints to retrieve, create, update, and handle bulk import templates of staff data. The class is annotated as a JAX-RS resource with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: StaffApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing staff management operations via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of staff members, optionally filtered by office, hierarchy, and status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new staff member using provided staff data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific staff member by ID, with optional template data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing staff member's details.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk staff data upload.

methods.name: postTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading of staff bulk import Excel files.
